usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, Activities of Interbank Foreign Exchange Market for 30.10.2026 (bank-customer dealing, day weighted average rate)
usdRate.note: Day weighted average of bank-customer USD trades (traded range 2,106-3,995); the CBM reference rate is fixed at 2,100 but most transactions use the market rate (CSO lists a money-changer rate of 3,670).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: World Bank Myanmar Economic Monitor press release (16 June 2026)
inflation_cpi.note: 24.6% year on year in April 2026 after a fuel-price shock; the CSO's own series (via Trading Economics) stops at Q2 2023. IMF WEO: 21.1% for 2025, 20% forecast for 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF WEO projections (16% in 2027, 10% in 2028, 7.8% from 2029); no credible inflation target
inflation_projection.note: CPI averaged over 20% in 2022-2025 and the IMF expects a slow decline, so we plan with 12% as a long-run average.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, Central Bank Rate (home page)
policy_rate.note: 9% a year, shown in the rates panel of the CBM home page (the only official page we found that shows the current rate; the CBM interest-rate statistics file stops in January 2023 at 7%). CBM also sets a 7% minimum deposit rate and a 15% maximum lending rate.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, minimum bank deposit rate (home page)
savings_account_rate.note: CBM sets a 7% floor on bank deposit rates; savings accounts at large banks typically pay at or near the floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Bank fixed deposit rate pages could not be read; the CBM minimum deposit rate is 7%.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Bank fixed deposit rate pages could not be read; the CBM minimum deposit rate is 7%.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme or published rate found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 5.83% for 2020, the latest World Bank figure (older than 2025); the CBM minimum deposit rate has since risen from 5% to 7%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No current government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, market weighted average accepted rates at the treasury bill auction (3-month)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 5.993% at the second May 2023 auction, the latest figure published on the CBM site (older than 2025; 6-month 6.539%, 12-month 7.315%). The central bank rate has since risen from 7% to 9%, so current yields are likely higher.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, market weighted average accepted yields at the treasury bond auction (3.5-5.5 years, 7.5% coupon)
tbond_5y_rate.note: 8.493% in April 2023 for the 3.5-5.5-year band (7.5% coupon), the latest 5-year-band figure on the CBM site (older than 2025); the central bank rate has since risen from 7% to 9%.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Myanmar issues treasury bonds of up to about 5 years; no 10-year bond found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Myanmar, withholding taxes (reviewed 9 September 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: 0% withholding on interest paid to residents (15% for non-residents). Interest counts as business income for resident individuals and is taxed at progressive rates when non-employment income exceeds MMK 4.8 million a year (PwC, income determination).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: We could not find an official page describing a deposit insurance scheme or limit for Myanmar.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Central Bank of Myanmar, maximum bank lending rate (home page)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: CBM caps bank lending rates at 15% a year (home page rates panel); we treat this general cap as the ceiling on bank card credit, as no card-specific rule was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Yangon Stock Exchange record; CBM deposit floor
equity_return_low.note: The Yangon Stock Exchange has very few listings and a weak record, so the low case is far below deposit rates.

equity_return_base.sourceName: CBM minimum deposit rate 7% (untaxed) plus a small premium
equity_return_base.note: Thin market with a weak 10-year record, so base set only 2 points above the 7% safe deposit rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: CBM minimum deposit rate plus a full equity premium
equity_return_high.note: High case if listings deepen and returns keep pace with inflation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; kyat market rate (CSO statistics overview)
gold_return_low.note: Low case if gold stalls in dollars and the kyat holds near its current market rate of about 3,700-3,800 per dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend plus expected kyat depreciation; CSO market prices (24-carat gold about MMK 7 million per tikal, kyat about 3,600-3,800 per dollar)
gold_return_base.note: About 4% dollar gold trend plus about 9% a year kyat depreciation from the inflation gap with the US.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend plus expected kyat depreciation
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle with fast kyat depreciation, as in 2021-2024.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case near the last published 3-month bill yield. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBM minimum deposit rate (7%, untaxed for residents)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case at the 7% deposit floor. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near the last published 5-year bond yield. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No claim settlement ratio published by the insurance supervisor found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates in kyat found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: IMF WEO CPI projections; no medical CPI read
goal_inflation_health.note: With 71% of health spending out of pocket and many medicines imported, we plan 2 points above long-run inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: IMF WEO CPI projections; no education CPI read
goal_inflation_education.note: We plan 1 point above long-run inflation for private school and tuition fees.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source because the WHO GHO API was unavailable.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: OADR 11.0 in 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL), 16.1 in 2040 and 26.0 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net).

retirement_age_default.note: The Social Security Board site was not reachable; the old-age pension under the Social Security Law 2012 has not been confirmed as in operation.

retirement_age_government.note: No reachable official page with the civil-service retirement age found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case near the last published 3-month bill yield. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CBM minimum deposit rate (7%, untaxed for residents)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at the 7% deposit floor, the after-tax safe rate. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

retirement_return_high.note: High case between the deposit floor and bond yields. Safe MMK rates: CBM minimum bank deposit rate 7% (central bank rate 9%); last published auction yields 6.0% for 3-month bills and 8.5% for 3.5-5.5-year bonds (May 2023); no withholding tax on interest for residents.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of kyat deposits, gold and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% growth assets at the low case, 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of kyat deposits, gold and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half growth assets at 9% and half deposits at 7%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of kyat deposits, gold and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% growth assets at the high case and 40% bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The Department of Social Welfare site refused access, so we could not confirm whether a social pension is paid or its amount.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Current age rules for the social pension could not be confirmed from an official page.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity per year of service for private employees found.

public_pension_scheme.note: The Social Security Board site was not reachable; we could not confirm the terms or operation of the old-age pension under the Social Security Law 2012.

fdr_3m.note: Banks must pay at least the 7% CBM minimum deposit rate.

fdr_1y.localName: ပုံသေငွေအပ်စာရင်း
fdr_1y.note: Banks must pay at least the 7% CBM minimum deposit rate.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No current government savings certificate or retail savings bond found.

tbill_91d.localName: ငွေတိုက်လက်မှတ်
tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the CBM, mainly to banks.

tbond_5y.localName: ငွေတိုက်စာချုပ်
tbond_5y.note: 2- to 5-year bonds auctioned by the CBM.

equity_fund.note: No retail mutual or index funds; the Yangon Stock Exchange has only a few listed shares.

gold.note: Gold is widely bought at gold shops; the CSO publishes the 24-carat price per tikal.

pensionScheme.name: Social Security Board, Ministry of Labour
